title: Framework context for the uniform tail bound
html:
Remark. This proposition is tightly coupled to the \Phi_q-tower binding pipeline. The active framework instead uses JSJ decomposition with hyperbolic volumes; the result here is retained as the analogous tail bound on the \Phi_q side and remains mathematically correct.

The jet-tower tail bound (jet-tower convergence) is conditional on a uniform bound |\Delta^{(n)}(\varrho)| \leq \Delta_{\max}(\varrho) across jet levels n \ge 1. This proposition supplies an explicit \Delta_{\max} from operator-norm estimates on the Hecke standard representation, closing the open hypothesis in the archimedean (SDP rank-1) regime.
